resources.string: Your teams, players, sports and competitions, and when match cards may show over other apps. All of it stays on this TV.
Separate names with commas, e.g. Al Hilal, Real Madrid, Sinner
Follow a team, a player or a sport to set its alerts.
Kick-off: a reminder 10 minutes before. Goals: goals and the final score. All: the live score too.
Key moments only: no live score bubble, just goals (sets won, lead changes, race finish) and the final score.
In these hours nothing shows over other apps, except matches marked Always. The range may cross midnight.
